en: A hand-colored vintage postcard showing a tree-lined promenade beside a small lake. Elegantly dressed people in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along the path. On the right there is a decorative railing and wooden bench, and in the background spa buildings are partly visible among the trees. The caption text in red at the bottom identifies the location and publisher in German.
